description: Hierarchical expand/collapse list (files, categories). The WAI-ARIA tree: Up/Down move between VISIBLE rows, Right expands or steps into a group, Left collapses or steps out, Enter selects. Controlled selection and expansion, or self-managed. Copy: node labels are the things' own names, and the level is carried by the structure, so a label never repeats its parent.

props.name: expandedIds
props.description: Expanded node ids; omit to let the tree manage them.
